releaseNotes:
## Conference families
- Simplified grouping: search for members, choose the main person, and edit the family in one screen.
- Moved contact details into the editor, with editable first and last names and optional email.
- Reuse existing contact and family links automatically, with an optional Change family action.
- Save directly when details match. Review only different room or travel details and moves between families.
- Show a live summary of shared travel from the main family member.
- Preserve selected rooms when grouping families across multiple rooms.

Individual travel exceptions, meal selections, late registrations and historical booking details are preserved.
